about: Situations met while forging the core (phase 2), each a chain of events up to its cataclysm, with the solution that got past it.

chains.solution: The bump wrote package.json with its arrays expanded and biome wanted them on one line: biome formats every package.json expanded (an override), and a test pins it.
A draft of the owner is kept as written: its directory is left out of biome (examples/00-draft-snippets).
The open pull request follows its branch: scripts/workflows/pull-request.sh edits its title and description to the version it releases now.
Tests build user:token@host URLs from parts, so no literal sits in the source.
The owner renews the token in the publish-env environment; the mirrors step continues on error, so the run and the work go on.
The workflow pushed its bump to development: fetch, merge origin/development (the version merge driver takes the higher), push again. Pull development before every batch.
Checks of a pull request opened by github-actions[bot] wait: the owner presses Approve and run, or the next push to revision runs them.
Shorten the header to 100 characters. The bump and the staged files stay staged: check git show --stat of the next commit, so nothing of the failed one rides along.
